classification_rationale: An unreadable *project* directory is recorded by discover_claude_sessions' own project_dir.iterdir() error branch and withholds the whole tool - a different branch from claude-partial-tree's companion payload directory, which is the only one E06-S02 repaired on the Rust side. Both must be pinned or repairing one leaves the other untested.

notes: Refusing destructive work on claude: the scan was incomplete, so absence of evidence cannot mean absence of data (1 unreadable path(s), e.g. <PROVIDER_ROOT>/projects/synthetic-project-e: Permission denied). Run `status` to see the full list.
